programme.desc: 国王玩他最喜欢的谢维斯玩具,玩得正开心时,莉塔要求想玩。国王认为自己是一个很好的分享者,就让给她。莉塔利用了国王的好心,很快就把他所有的玩具都骗走了!尽管莉塔一开始感到得意洋洋,但她的快乐却短暂。莉塔必须发现玩具最好的地方;就是当你与他人分享时,你会获得更多乐趣。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #8
programme.desc: 莉塔终于离渡渡鸟足够接近来抚摸它—但只是因为牠弄伤了脚。她把这只小动物带回家,用爱喂养牠,还给牠吃太多的食物。现在超重的渡渡鸟非常需要运动。莉塔明白到所谓的关心,是要对他人有好处,而不是对自己有益。如此一来,现在有了一个新的好朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #9
programme.desc: 在看似平常的一天,姑毛出去慢跑时发现今天的啫堡略有不同。一切都停止不动!音乐停了。渡渡鸟停留在空中。连他的朋友们都僵硬得像雕像!这取决于姑毛和他有用的耳机来找出发生了甚么事,并让啫堡再次动起来。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #10
programme.desc: 在啫堡上探索春天的音乐本质时,姑毛意识到他害怕唱歌花。为了寻找治疗方法,米娜进行了一系列测试,以帮助姑毛处理他对唱歌植物的过度反应。最后姑毛意识到,当你了解自己的恐惧,就没甚么可怕的了。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #11
programme.desc: 姑毛发现了一个嘈杂的重金属摇滚音乐盒,他认为这很棒,但却令啫堡的其他人都抓狂。必须做点甚么!比路和米娜骗了姑毛并用魔术让盒子「消失」。没有了他的「劲爆音乐」盒子,姑毛十分苦恼。比路和米娜意识到音乐对姑毛有多重要,并让盒子重新出现。姑毛在过程中意识到即使他们不喜欢他的音乐也没关系,他有很多音乐盒可以满足每个人!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #12
programme.desc: 由于国王的奇怪睡眠习惯,女王把他赶出了城堡。被黑影和不寻常的声音所笼罩,国王立即到比路的房子寻求庇护,但他们离睡个好觉还很远。经过一系列奇怪的睡前仪式,比路终于明白问题所在,并帮助国王克服对夜晚的恐惧。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #13
programme.desc: 姑毛在啫喱莓树林里睡著了。国王在附近尝试用一台异常强大的机器打开他的汽水瓶,这台机器最终撞倒了啫喱树!姑毛在废墟中惊恐地醒来!他说服自己是罪魁祸首!比路和米娜收集线索,让国王为自己的行为负责,并让姑毛认清事实。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #14
programme.desc: 米娜发明了一个巨型机器人来给啫堡换灯泡。比路认为机械人应该用来保护啫堡免受入侵者的侵扰!在米娜不知情的情况下,他修改了「啫堡机械人」的程式,导致它发生故障,并大肆破坏啫喱星。比路明白了「别碰我的东西!」这句话背后的含义。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #15
programme.desc: 皇家花园中的女王之歌果实被盗。侦探二人组啫堡侠和拍档侠需要破案。每个人都是疑犯。他们的聆听技巧和团队合作帮助他们抓住水果贼。这真是一个惊喜—即使对小偷亦然。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #16
programme.desc: 在下午茶时间,莉塔失去了公主的踪迹。她疯狂地在啫堡寻人,但没有找到她最好的朋友。比路看到莉塔很伤心。他发誓要让她开心,让她忘记公主。他做到了!不过,当公主再次出现,比路却感到没有朋友。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #17
programme.desc: 女王去度假,留给国王很多职务。他立即采取行动,找其他人来做。莉塔肯帮助国王……如果她能成为啫堡的女王!起初,所有孩子都很高兴自己有份负责。不过,很快乐趣和游戏就被只有莉塔开心的游戏所取代。小女王必须意识到这种权力是如何冲昏她的头脑。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #18
programme.desc: 孩子们围坐在篝火旁讲恐怖故事。姑毛讲述了最可怕的怪物故事,然后去吃点心。不过,他走得太远!其他人必须在黑暗的树林里寻找他!神秘的影子和声音很快让他们都以为有怪物在跟踪他们!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #35
programme.desc: 莉塔和公主正在举行一场可爱的粉红色野餐: 粉红色的菜肴、粉红色的食物、粉红色的一切!莉塔向公主倾诉她希望啫堡上的所有东西都是她最喜欢的颜色。她冲到音乐工厂,将五颜六色的音乐泡泡变成粉红色,这可能会让一切变得一样!当其他孩子意识到莉塔的行动时,他们必须在啫堡变成一片大而无聊、贫瘠的粉红色荒地前,努力恢复其自然多样性!

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #36
programme.desc: 姑毛和莉塔正在户外度过愉快的一天,突然发现一颗渡渡鸟蛋。孩子们和小鸡蛋将进行动作连场的冒险。经过这么多的喧嚣,鸟蛋能存活下来吗?

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #37
programme.desc: 音盘已经疯了,啫堡中的所有声音都被改变,造成了巨大的混乱。比路和莉塔将负责将每一个声音归还到它所属的地方。

programme.title: 「唱」游啫喱星 #38
programme.desc: 比路必须戴眼罩。他因外表而感到不舒服和沮丧。幸运的是,他的朋友们用一首歌的智慧提醒他,任何问题都可以变成有趣的事情。

programme.desc: This supernatural action-adventure is based on Mike Mignola's acclaimed Dark Horse Comics series. Brought to Earth by evil genius Rasputin (Karel Roden) to aid the Nazis in their dying cause, Hellboy (Ron Perlman) was rescued by Professor Broom (John Hurt), founder of the clandestine B.P.R.D. (Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense), who raised him and developed his extraordinary paranormal gifts. Despite his dark origins, Hellboy becomes an unlikely champion for good, battling the evil forces that threaten our world along with a telepathic “mer-man” (Doug Jones) and a “pyro-kinetic” (Selma Blair). Hidden from the society they are assigned to protect, they are the key line of defense against Rasputin, who seeks to reclaim Hellboy to the dark side and use his powers to bring about Armageddon.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancée to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Disciples Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Yi is a skilled disciple of the Hong Quan style kung fu who work in a textile mill recommended by his senior, Han. Han warns Yi not to show off his martial arts skill so as to avoid getting into trouble. However, Yi does not listen and eventually gets dangerously involved in the conflict between two opposing textile mills.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family…

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Lei Yu has officially become the new generation of Chinese test pilots after rounds of strict selection. Captain Zhang Ting leads Lei Yu and other pilots to test the latest fighter jets. Lei Yu keeps pushing the limits in each test flight in the hope of coming up with the perfect plane to ensure the safety of the fighter pilots.

programme.title: Cyber Heist
programme.desc: Hackers have caused a large-scale cyber attack, but luckily cyber security engineer Chun, manages to fend it off with his protective firewall system. To Chun's surprise, his boss is the mastermind of the attack, and when Chun gets trapped in a money laundering operation, he must fight against his boss in the cyber world to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: In this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature Film, Nian faces relentless bullying from her peers as she prepares for her college entrance exam. Fate leads her to streetwise punk Bei, but before they can retreat into their own world, both are embroiled in a murder investigation that will change their lives forever.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: The Monkey King 3
programme.desc: Monkey King, Pigsy and Sandy escort Monk Tang to retrieve the scriptures and accidentally head into the mysterious Female Kingdom. The Queen falls in love with Monk Tang at first sight, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be executed. As the four attract the appearance of River Spirit, the Female Kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighbouring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: A businessman Qin Guo Li is being kidnapped in London and his daughter is also in danger. The international security team, Vanguard, is hired to rescue them. Tang Huan Ting, the founder, gathers an elite team to track them down across countries, from London to Africa and Dubai. In the process, they also discover another dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: This film celebrates the 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's Handover in a series of four cultural stories about young Hong Kongers from different walks of life: a young man with autism pursuing his dream, a reconciliation between father and son, a Chinese opera star helping young pop singers, and a Nepali youth becoming a professional lion dancer.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News

As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales
programme.desc: Zebra was once very easy to spot in Tinga Tinga as he was bright white all over. This very annoying as all he wanted was to be left alone to munch on yummy grass and get fat. Zebra accompanies Tortoise and the Monkeys into the Cave where they discover the last remaining item; a plain black coat. The Monkeys persuade Zebra to try it on. By holding in his stomach, Zebra manages to get the coat on but it is extremely tight and the black coat starts to rip. In fact, the more Zebra eats the more the coat rips until Zebra has a stripy black and white coat which he is extremely proud of. programme.title: Jin Notti

programme.title: Cinta Kura-kura

programme.title: 1 Lawan Satu

Saleh dibesarkan dengan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri dan kini sedang mencari adiknya yang telah hilang. Radhi pula bertarung demi menyelamatkan adik perempuannya, Sara, yang sedang sakit tenat dan memerlukan RM50,000 untuk rawatan.

programme.title: Reaksiar

programme.title: Pisau Cukur

Siapakah pemangsa dan siapakah mangsa? Dalam pelayaran yang penuh dengan kejutan, apa sahaja boleh berlaku!

programme.title: Mamak Cupcake

programme.title: Nana Dan Jam Atok

programme.title: Ruang Temu

programme.title: Gila Gila Remaja 2

Kisahnya lebih fokus pada hidup remaja kolej & sekolah memandu, dengan isu sosial yang dekat dengan golongan muda — persaingan, cinta segitiga, serta impian masing-masing.

programme.title: Jhangri

programme.title: Great Blue Wild

Its reef, one the largest living structures on the planet, is home to more than 1,500 species of fish.

programme.title: Wild Castles

programme.title: Wild Castles

programme.title: Wild Castles

programme.title: Wild Castles

programme.title: Stormborn

programme.title: Stormborn

programme.title: Life's Journey

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades - but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Life's Journey

programme.title: Kerana Cinta Itu Dusta
programme.desc: Selepas mahkamah, Orked diserbu wartawan hingga sugul, sementara Mikael rasa bersalah kerana mahu menyokongnya. Seri dan Sufian mempergunakan situasi untuk mempromosikan perniagaan sambal, melibatkan Saif dan Putri, manakala Hanis cuba panaskan keadaan. Orked marah melihat anaknya dipergunakan untuk marketing, namun Mikael menasihati Orked untuk fokus strategi baru. Orked menggunakan wartawan neutral untuk keluarkan artikel “Rezeki Orang Teraniaya”, memulakan kembali langkahnya, manakala Hanis, Sufian dan Zaleha mula tertekan dan tertanya-tanya tentang rancangan Orked. Keesokan harinya, Orked dilantik sebagai duta, dengan Mikael dan Puan Anira memberi sokongan moral dan nasihat.

programme.title: 7 Minggu Sebelum Kahwin

Namun dengan hanya tujuh minggu sahaja sebelum hari besar, pelbagai konflik dan kekacauan berlaku, dari cincin kahwin yang tidak kena bentuk hingga kad jemputan yang dicetak salah. Setiap kekusutan menggugat kepercayaan dan hubungan cinta antara Syifa dan Amar (MK K Clique). Ketika tekanan bertambah, kemunculan bekas kekasih Amar (Natasha) membawa ketegangan besar yang akhirnya menjadi pertikaian antara mereka. Adakah Syifa dan Amar berjaya mengharungi konflik ini menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka?

Tetapi apabila obsesi Maria semakin mendalam, dia berisiko kehilangan sesuatu yang jauh lebih berharga daripada lelaki yang dia cintai.

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu
programme.desc: Ketika kesedihan melanda, Ameena dan Zarif mendapati diri mereka semakin jauh. Harris menggesa Ameena supaya berhenti sebelum terlambat. Tetapi apabila Ameena bersemuka dengan Maria, apa yang sepatutnya membawa keamanan hanya mendedahkan situasi yang lebih genting.

programme.title: 7 Minggu Sebelum Kahwin
programme.desc: Syifa (Nora Danish) mengimpikan majlis perkahwinan impian sejak kecil. Setiap kekusutan menggugat kepercayaan dan hubungan cinta antara Syifa dan Amar (MK K Clique). Ketika tekanan bertambah, kemunculan bekas kekasih Amar (Natasha) membawa ketegangan besar yang akhirnya menjadi pertikaian antara mereka. Adakah Syifa dan Amar berjaya mengharungi konflik ini menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka?

programme.title: Saat Aku Tahu

programme.title: Sahabat Backpackers
programme.desc: Memaparkan Dai Raisyah dan Dai Shafiqah sebagai hos rancangan mengembara ke Aceh, Indonesia. Banda Aceh telah dilanda Tsunami pada 29 Disember 2004, telah mengorbankan seramai 46,718 penduduknya. Lokasi pertama yang dikunjungi ialah Kuburan Massal. Seramai 46, 718 mangsa terkorban mangsa Tsunami telah dikebumikan di sini. Saudara Irfan Kamal salah seorang pelajar Malaysia di sini menceritakan detik-detik berlaku Tsunami. Katanya dalam keadaan dharurat, mereka yang meninggal dunia boleh dikebumikan secara beramai-ramai. Terdapat sebuah bot tersangkut pada sebuah rumah dan masih dikekalkan, bot ini telah menyelamatkan 59 orang. Hos mengunjungi keluarga Syaifun Muhammad Yusri dan isterinya Puan Nilawati Ilyas yang merupakan mangsa tsumani. Mereka menceritakan detik-detik kejadian sehingga kehilangan ibu dan anak mereka. Pelancong Malaysia telah mewakafkan sebidang tanah dan pembinaan masjid di sana. Masih terdapat sebuah masjid masih ampuh dan tidak terkesan dengan kejadian tsunami iaitu Masjid Tahmatullah. Seterusnya ke Masjid Agung Al-Makmur Lampriek. Pada setiap hujung minggu jalan raya ditutup bagi membolehkan penduduk beriadah dan bersenam. Hos juga mengunjungi kapal besar yang dinamakan Rumah Apung. Kapal ini menjadi sebagai sumber menjana letrik kepada orang kampung terletak di tepi pantai. Kapal ini sepanjang 63 meter mampu 1.5 kilo watt letrik.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Masing-masing ketandusan idea. Ustaz Yasin mencadangkan pelajarpelajarnya dikenakan yuran sekolah. Adam kelihatan berat mahu menerima cadangan itu. Dia pasti ramai yang tidak akan mampu membayar yuran, memandangkan kebanyakan mereka pelajar miskin. Dalam pada itu, muncul Hamadi dengan wajah bengis memegang cek ditangannya. Rupanya cek itu sudah di "block" oleh Adam. Hamadi berpura-pura melutut sambil menangis dan merayu pada Adam agar cek itu, kononnya adalah gajinya, dapat ditunaikan. Dia mahu membeli kereta Mercedez idamannya. Adam bukan saja semakin meluat, malah menyuruh Hamadi melepaskan kakaknya. Nur semakin tidak sedap hati Juita yang kini menetap di rumahnya, seringkali beritahu betapa untungnya jika dia dapat suami seperti Adam. Sesekali Juita ada bergurau dan menyindir Nur tentang masa lalu dan janji mereka untuk bermadu, membuatkan Nur bertambah gelisah. Namun, memikirkan Juita sudah membantunya mendapatkan sewa surau yang rendah, dia terpaksa buat tidak kisah sahaja. Jojo geram mendapat tahu Juita menumpang di rumah Nur. Dia menasihati Nur agar tidak terperangkap dengan kelicikan Juita yang akan merampas suaminya kelak. Kata Nur, Juita ikhlas mahu berubah. Juita pura-pura mahu keluar dari rumah itu jika Nur tetap merasa curiga. Nur jadi serba salah dan minta Juita terus tinggal dengannya walaupun merasa sesuatu yang tidak kena dengan Juita. Sementara itu, Nek Mak terdengar khabar angin sekolah Darul Mukhsin akan ditutup kerana masalah kewangan. Ketika singgah untuk makan tengah hari di rumah Suraya, Amirul yang tidak tahu menahu panik seketika mendengarnya dari mulut Mak Nek. Dia tergesa-gesa mahu dapatkan kepastian dari Adam. Sementara itu, Aisyah tiada jalan lain melainkan mencari kerja demi mempertahankan suaminya Hamadi dari hukuman mahkamah nanti. Adam tidak mahu masalah sekolah itu melibatkan ayahnya. Dia akhirnya menandatangani surat pekeliling bagi mengenakan yuran kepada pelajar Darul Mukhsin demi menyelamatkan sekolah itu. Namun separuh dari pelajarnya akan dipindahkan kerana tidak mampu untuk membayar yuran.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Nur tidak keruan dan tidak tahan dengan permainan Juita.Dia teringat kembali janjinya untuk bermadu dengan Juita sekiranya dia berkahwin. Saat mahu menghalau Juita, Nur serba salah mendengar doa-doa Juita dalam solatnya. Satu hari, Juita semakin berani menggoda Ust Adam dengan berpura-pura pening dan seakan rebah. Adam terpaksa memapahnya ke bilik semasa ketiadaan Nur. Cubaan Juita gagal apabila Nur pulang ke rumah. Jantung Adam berdegup laju teringatkan adegan itu. Dia tidak menjawab sebarang pertanyaan Nur. Dia tidak mahu lagi Juita tingal di rumahnya tetapi Juita tetap mempertahankan sahabatnya itu. Adam terus keluar rumah membuatkan Nur tergamam. Juita mula meraih simpati berpura-pura bersiap untuk keluar dari rumah itu. Sambil menangis, dia memfitnah Adam cuba melakukan perkara tidak senonoh padanya dan menuduh Adam tidak ikhlas membimbingnya. Sebaliknya, Nur tidak bersimpati malah menghalau Juita. Nur juga mahu batalkan sewa surau untuk kelas mengaji. Dia tidak mahu lagi bersahabat dengan Juita yang membuatnya membelakangkan suaminya. Sementara di hotel, Hamadi semakin terdesak untuk mendapatkan wang dan juga melempiaskan nafsunya di lorong itu. Hasratnya melacurkan Aishah dengan dua lelaki tidak kesampaian kerana Aishah keluar ketika itu. Aishah amat marah dan merasa terhina. Dia nekad mahukan cerai tetapi Hamadi memujuknya untuk mencari kerja dan memberi segala kemewahan pada Aishah. Aishah masih trauma. Suasana di Sek. Darul Mukhsin hiba dengan berita dari pekeliling untuk mengenakan yuran sekolah. Beberapa pelajar miskin bersiap-siap untuk pulang dan menangis kesedihan. Amirul yang mendapat tahu Suraya menghantar surat berhenti tergamam lantas memberitahu Ayah Hj. Adam hanya mampu melihat suasana muram di sekolah itu dari bilik pejabatnya. Dia kemudian menerima panggilan Nur memujuknya untuk pulang dan lega apabila Nur menyatakan dia telah menghalau Juita. Remuk hati Ayah Hj mendapat tahu Sek Darul Mukhsin bakal ditutup. Dia ke sekolah itu setelah gagal menghubungi Adam. Adam kaget apabila ayah Hj muncul menyoal sebab Adam tidak berbincang dengannya terlebih dahulu mengenai masalah sekolah itu.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Adam pilih jalan itu buat sementara waktu demi menyelamatkan sekolah itu. Namun, menurut Ayah Hj adalah lebih adil sekiranya sekolah itu ditutup, kerana tujuan menubuhkan sekolah itu untuk memberi peluang pelajar terutamanya yang tidak berkemampuan. Adam yang rindukan Nur membelinya sejambak bunga. Ketika itu, dia terlihat Nur bersama Dr Mukhriz lantas berasa cemburu dan berlalu pergi. Dia tahu Dr Mukhriz pernah menyimpan perasaan terhadap Nur suatu ketika dahulu. Setibanya di rumah, Adam dapati Juita di situ dan cuba menggodanya. Alangkah terkejutnya apabila Nur pulang dan melihat Juita di katil bersama Adam yang sedang tidur tidak berbaju dan berlakulah satu pertengkaran. Juita memfitnah Adam telah merogolnya. Nur menghalau serta memutuskan persahabatannya dengan Juita. Nur merajuk, menangis membawa diri ke lorong. Adam yang terjaga terpinga-pinga cuba menghubungi Nur tetapi gagal. Dia terlihat sekeping kad "I love you" dan timbul rasa serba salah. Sementara itu, Amirul pula sibuk mencari Suraya hingga ke pasar. Dia tidak setuju Suraya berhenti belajar dan sanggup menanggung Suraya. Dia akhirnya mengaku di hadapan Nek Mak bahawa dia menyayangi Suraya dan sangup susah demi orang tersayang. Amirul pulang ke rumah dalam keadaan lesu kerana penat membantu Suraya di pasar dan dimarahi Ibu Hjh. Ayah Hj ke bilik Amirul dan bertanya siapa gadis yang membuat Amirul angau. Amirul tersenyum dengan jenaka Ayah Hj dan mula bercerita. Di hotel, Aishah yang masih trauma telah hubungi Ibu Hjh tentang niatnya mahu bercerai dengan Mahadi dan kembali ke pangkuan keluarga. Ketika itu, Hamadi terus mencari kerja tetapi mengecewakan sehingga ternampak iklan sebuah Maahad TahfizDarul Fatah. Dia akhirnya diterima sebagai pengurus di situ. Hamadi pulang ke hotel untuk menjemput Aisyah tetapi terkejut melihat cincin di atas meja. Hamadi beritahu dia sudah bersusah-payah mendapatkan kerja, langsaikan hutang, membeli kereta dan rumah baru. Walau begitu Aishah tidak sanggup lagi hidup dengan lelaki sepeti Hamadi. Hamadi naik hantu dan membelasah Aishah hingga lebam di muka. Aishah menjadi trauma mengikut saja telunjuk Mahadi ke rumah baru. Rupa-rupanya Mahadi telah menyalahgunakan cek sekolah tahfiz itu untuk kegunaan peribadinya. Sekali lagi Hamadi mengamuk apabila Aishah mempersoal punca duit segala kemewahan hanya dalam sekelip mata itu.

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Adam cuba hubungi Ibu Hjh bertanyakan Nur tetapi Nur tiada di situ. Keesokannya Nur pulang setelah terlena di kaki lorong, bertalu-talu soalan dan tuduhan dari Adam akibat sangsi dan cemburunya terhadap Dr Mukhriz. Nur masih sakit hati pada mulanya berdiam, kemudian menceritakan dia ke hospital dan hampir pengsan ketika membeli kad buat Adam. Ketika pulang kemarin, dia terkejut melihat Juita berada di katil mereka ketika Adam sedang tidur. Adam benar-benar keliru tidak menyedari apa yang telah berlaku. Dia pasti Juita telah sabotajnya. Nur hanya mampu menangis mengadu pada sahabatnya Jojo. Nur kesal dialah punca segalanya. Atas nasihat Jojo, Nur minta maaf pada Adam dan mereka berbaik semula. Adam geram lalu bersemuka, memberi amaran pada Juita, perbuatannya langsung tidak menggugat cintanya pada Nur. Keitka Nur cuba beritahu sebab dia ke hospital, muncul 2 pegawai polis menahan Adam atas tuduhan merogol. Juita dalam diam bersekongkol dengan Hamadi memisahkan Nur dan Adam kerana Hamadi masih bertekad menuntut habuannya, Nur. Di Sek Darul Fatah, Hamadi menunjukkan belangnya. Dia kononnya mahu mengajar pelajar-pelajarnya berdikari dengan mengutip derma. Ibu Hjh risau Aisyah yang tidak kunjung, tiba telah ke rumah Aisyah dan terkejut mendapati muka Aisyah lebam-lebam. Dalam keadaan cemas mengajak Aishah pulang, Hamadi muncul dan terjadi satu pertelingkahan. Hamadi berpuas hati kerana dendamnya terbayar apabila berjaya menghalau Ibu Hjh secara kejam dengan memukul ibu mertuanya itu. Keberanian iblis Hamadi semakin menjadi jadi. Aishah yang lemah dan trauma sering dipukul tidak dapat berbuat apa-apa, sedih terkenangkan Hamadi yang dikenalinya dulu seorang yang sopan santun tetapi kini segalanya berubah bagai mimpi ngeri. Hamadi tidak mahu Aishah jadi isteri derhaka dan memaksa Aishah putuskan hubungan dengan keluarganya. Kemarahan Ayah Hj semakin membuak mendengar hal itu tetapi ditenteramkan semula oleh Ibu Hjh. Beliau turut sedih kerana terpaksa menjual Sek. Darul Mukhsin yang dibinanya namun kembali mengukir senyuman apabila seorang Datuk misteri mahu membantu membiayai semula sekolah itu. Beberapa ketika kemudian, beliau mendapat serangan jantung mengetahui Adam ditangkap polis atas tuduhan merogol

programme.title: Nur
programme.desc: Bagaikan luluh jantung Aishah mendengar perbualan "loud speaker" Hamadi dengan Juita mensabotaj Adam hingga dituduh merogol. Puas hati Hamadi dendamnyadengan Ibu hjh terbalas. Nur bergegas ke hospital bertemu Ibu Hjh. Ibu Hjh tidak percaya Adam melakukan perbuatan terkutuk itu. Peguam Jalal membawa Nur bertemu Adam dan membuat laporan polis. Adam begitu lega dapat bertemu Nur tetapi bertambah serabut mengetahui ayahnya mendapat serangan jantung berpunca darinya. Peguam Jalal serba salah beritahu Nur hasil laporan hospital menyebelahi Juita. Nur terus ke rumah Juita dan satu penampar hingga ke muka Juita. Juita akui perbuatan jahatnya kerana dendam. Dia juga telah membunuh Marzuki kerana cemburu. Nur tergamam, dia melutut dan merayu agar Juita melepaskan pertuduhannya terhadap Adam. Nur akur dengan syarat Juita untuk melepaskan Adam dan membiarkan mereka berkahwin. Hamadi berpuas hati mendengar berita Juita itu. Ketika Adam dibebaskan, peguam Jalal menceritakan laporan hospital adalah sahih. Adam naik angin kerana tidak percaya ia berlaku di luar kawalannya. Lebih-lebih lagi Nur sudah tahu perkara itu. Adam bergegas mendapatkan Nur meminta maaf, tetapi Nur pasrah mahu akhiri perkahwinan mereka. Dia sudah berjanji dengan Juita, juga demi maruah keluarga. Uchee terdengar perbualan mereka. Ketika Hamadi bersama pelajar-pelajarnya mengutip derma di pasar, dia terlihat Suraya. Hamadi yang hidung belang menawar Suraya sambung pelajar di Sek. Darul Fatah secara percuma termasuk tempat tinggal. Nek Mak tidak sedap hati tetapi Suraya tidak mahu peluang itu disia-siakan. Aishah terkejut Hamadi membawa seorang gadis ke rumah tetapi takut bersuara. Suraya cuba minta Aisyah lepaskannya tetapi Aisyah takut. Uchee datang ke rumah Juita memberitahu dia tidak mahu lagi bersubahat. Juita panik terus menghubungi Hamadi mengenai rahsia mereka sudah terbongkar. Hamadi tidak peduli lagi jika Nur tidak jatuh ke tangannya, kerana sudah ada pengganti lebih muda di rumahnya iaitu Suraya. Dengan rakusnya, Hamadi cuma memperkosa Suraya. Aishah melihat kejadian itu hilang pedoman, mengampil sebilah pisau lalu menikam-nikam Hamadi sehingga tidak lagi bernyawa lagi. Uchee yang tidak sanggup melihat perpisahan Adam dan Nur akhirnya memberitahu perkara sebenar bahawa dia diupah Juita membeli pil khayal untuk mengenakan Adam. Adam dan Nur bergegas membuat laporan polis. Juita merasakan tidak selamat lagi selepas kehadiran Uchee. Sebaik bersiap-siap untuk lari dan membuka pintu, dua orang polis menahannya. Di hospital, Ayah Hj semakin pulih. Peguam Jalal membawa dermawan misteri bertemu Ayah Hj. Di rumah Suraya pula, Ibu Hjh datang melawat Mak Nek, mohon maaf dengan penuh rasa bersalah. Ibu Hajah juga melawat Aishah di penjara yang kelihatan tenang setelah apa yang berlaku. Justeru menghadapi keperitan dalam pelbagai tekanan Ustaz Adam dan Nur bertekad menjual rumah yang menjadi tempat kelahiran Nur. Adam begitu gembira mendengar berita dia bakal menimang cahaya mata.

programme.title: Trails to Hakka
programme.desc: Taiwans Raknus Selu Trail, the countrys longest national nature trail, becomes the setting for a cross-cultural journey linking Taiwan and Korea. Led by Hakka artist Rio Peng and Korea-based YouTuber Baik Du, Korean artists Kim Ha Nel, Nam Wooh Yun, and Lee Jun Young explore the trail on foot, discovering its landscapes, culture, and healing power. YouTuber

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: This show focuses on the issues that are most important to urban modern women. It combines current events with discussions of life's major and minor problems and invites various specialists to address various difficulties. Netizens will occasionally attend the show to share their own stories and ask questions of the guests and experts, making the topics more relevant and audience-focused!

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: The show 'Top Singers' aims to spotlight outstanding Taiwanese singers and composers, setting a new standard in the industry. Combining elements of competition, variety, and personal stories, the show welcomes participants of all ages. Its goals include discovering grassroots talent, innovating Taiwanese song performance styles, and involving more local talent in song composition to infuse new life into Taiwanese music.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Every second counts in "Show Biz" to bring you with the most High Speed star news, exciting live shows and performers interviews.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Love, Now
programme.desc: Lan Shi De, who lost his first love in college, reunites with Yang Yi Ru in a foreign land. When he learns she has only six months to live, he decides to marry her and fulfill her dream wedding. Eight days later, she mysteriously disappears, and Shi De vows not to let true love slip away again.

programme.title: Ke Medan Jaya
programme.desc: Hisham tinggal bersama ibunya, Mak Jah. Bapanya yang bekerja sebagai anggota tentera telah meninggal dunia akibat serangan musuh semasa zaman darurat. Sejak kematian suaminya, Mak Jah bekerja sebagai pembantu rumah dengan seorang hartawan bernama Pak Samad. Pak Samad dan isterinya tidak pernah menganggap Mak Jah sebagai pembantu rumah, malah Hisham dianggap seperti anak mereka sendiri dan mendapat pendidikan yang sama dengan Haryati, anak hartawan tersebut. Apabila wujud kemesraan antara mereka berdua, ibu bapa Haryati merasa bimbang kerana Haryati telah ditunangkan dengan Shahril. Setelah mengetahui kisah sebenar, Hisham mengambil Keputusan untuk menyertai angkatan tentera walaupun ditentang oleh ibunya.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 1
programme.desc: Dua beradik berbeza perwatakan - Maria, anak kebanggaan keluarga yang cemerlang dalam pelajaran - manakala Mariana, anak yang sering memberontak dan liar. Maria membesar menjadi seorang anggota polis namun Mariana masih sama seperti dahulu. Persengketaan terjadi apabila keduanya menyukai lelaki yang sama. Diculik geng, Maria sanggup menaruhkan nyawa demi menyelamatkan Mariana.

programme.title: Maria Mariana 2
programme.desc: Maria dikejarkan ke hospital dan menemui cinta bersama doktor yang menyelamatkannya. Kemudiannya, dia ditugaskan untuk membanteras sindiket pengedaran dadah. Hubungan Maria dan Mariana kembali tegang apabila bekas kekasih Mariana muncul kembali. Cara hidup liar Mariana menyebabkan dia diperalatkan dan menimbulkan kekacauan dalam hidup mereka.

programme.title: SH3
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang percintaan dan persaingan siapa yang terbaik antara pemain papan selaju ketika kemuncak musik Hip Hop dan sukan papan selaju di negara. Khairul, ingin menjadi pemain papan selaju yang terbaik tetapi menemui kesulitan kerana lawannya, Mario yang juga sama mahir. Ingin memenangi hati Nelly, Khairul ingin terus membuktikan kehandalannya. Pada masa yang sama, Mario dan Mawar berpakat bersama-sama untuk memastikan mereka mendapat Khairul dan Nelly untuk diri mereka sendiri. Sikap setiakawan dan keluarga menjadi penyokong kuat Khairul untuk berjaya.

programme.title: Cinta Metropolitan
programme.desc: Haris, seorang jurugambar bertemu semula dengan adiknya yang terkenal sebagai seorang casanova, Irwan. Tidak begitu senang dengan perangai adiknya yang suka menggoda sesiapa sahaja termasuk kekasihnya sendiri, hubungan mereka renggang. Satu sindiket pemalsuan wang terbongkar menyebabkan Haris, Irwan, Monisa dan dua orang lagi diburu sindiket itu sehingga ke luar negara.

programme.title: Castello
programme.desc: Solo mula menjalankan kegiatan sebagai pengedar dadah untuk menjadikan kehidupan keluarganya lebih mewah. Tapi Solo tertangkap dan dia dipenjara selama 20 tahun. Di dalam penjara, dia dikenali sebagai Castello. Keluar dari penjara, Castello cuba mengesan semula isteri dan anaknya. Tapi dia kecewa bila mengetahui anak gadisnya Phim telah menjadi penagih dadah. Castello berusaha untuk menyelamatkan Phim yang tidak menyedari bahawa Castello adalah bapanya

programme.title: Sepi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tiga orang yang berasingan mengenal erti cinta, kehilangan dan kesepian. Adam, seorang tukang masak terkenal yang meluaskan kerjayanya dengan mereka hiasan untuk majlis perkahwinan. Tetapi, dengan segala kejayaan itu beliau masih membujang dan belum bertemu jodohnya sendiri. Sufi pula seorang lelaki yang sedang cuba melenyapkan memori kematian isterinya. Akhir sekali, Iman, seorang penulis muda yang menjadikan pentas teater sebagai tapak untuk memahami masa silamnya dan kupasan demi kupasan ke dalam masa depannya sendiri. Ketiga-tiga watak ini akhirnya terkait dalam satu insiden dramatik yang akan merubah kehidupan mereka buat selamanya.

programme.title: Warna-Warna Hati
programme.desc: Kisah seorang wanita yang terpaksa menguruskan sebuat syarikat besar tanpa bantuan keluarganya. Perniagaan syarikat milik keluarga Puan Rohani mengalami pelbagai masalah selepas Encik Osman, pengurus syarikat tersebut terlibat dalam kes penyelewengan wang syarikat. Anak-anak Puan Rohani yang tidak berminat untuk membantu ibunya dan mengambil tahu mengenai syarikat tersebut menyebabkan Puan Rohani memberi kepercayaan kepada Encik Osman. Puan Rohani juga cuba memujuk anak lelakinya, Hafsham yang baru tamat pengajian dari Amerika Syarikat untuk bekerja di syarikat itu dan membantunya untuk menguruskan syarikat

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Imperial Coroner, The (II)
programme.desc: The story of the aloof Prince An, Xiao Jinyu, and Chu Chu, the imperial-appointed female coroner, after their marriage! Their careers, relationships, and overall perspectives are all upgraded. Together with the youth team of the Three Judicial Offices, they uncover the truth and solve bizarre cases, working hand in hand to safeguard the peace of the Tang Dynasty.

programme.title: Pretty Dangerous & What's On Today
programme.desc: Some dope called Powder Gremlin is everywhere in the city. Undercover cop Poon Yik-fung (Mark Ma) has been mingling with wise guys and eventually brings narcotic chemist Kuen Sai-ho to justice, but the crook only receives a lenient sentence! Yik-fung asks his boss to consider extending the undercover operation with permission to recruit a contingent of undercover policewomen, and the aim is to investigate the mysterious mastermind behind Sai-ho's scheme. Yik-fung selects three pretty female decoys, each with their unique talents: Shum Kai-kei (Kelly Cheung), aka Female Sherlock Holmes; Kong Miu-chi (Jeannie Chan), aka Meticulous and Sharp-witted Martial Arts Expert; and Tung Siu-yue (Yuki Law), aka Ever-changing Walking Encyclopedia. They have to get close to philanthropic businessman Lau Biu (Eddie Kwan) and his wife Bonnie Ka (Maggie Shiu), and the only obstacle is their daughter Lau Po-yee (Yumi Chung). However, Yik-fung has some hidden agenda as he pushes the female decoys to carry out risky tasks.

programme.title: Lo And Behold
programme.desc: HUNG SHU-KAN (Lau Dan) built his own logistics business from scratch and now everything is in order. The only thing on his mind is the well-being of his three daughters. His eldest daughter has moved abroad, but his second youngest daughter, HUNG YUEK-SHUI (Koni Lui), is still single. She and her little prodigy sister, HUNG SUM-YUE (Andrea So), often fight over small things, putting their father in dilemmas.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Shining Just for You
programme.desc: The fantasy period drama "Shining Just for You" tells the story of Ye Ling Shuang (played by Peng Xiaoran), a grassland girl who is considered a jinx by her tribe because she can foresee disasters. Only Princess Qi Hai Rui (played by Liu Mengrui) of Ye Bei treats her like a sister. Ye Bei, overestimating its strength, launches a war against the Chao Kingdom, suffering a crushing defeat and losing many soldiers. Ye Ling Shuang is taken prisoner and sent to a brothel, but she refuses to submit. Using her talent for astrology, she enters the Imperial Observatory and gradually wins the heart of the ruthless emperor Yu Xiu Ming (played by Feng Shaofeng). However, just as their friendship deepens, Ye Ling Shuang learns of Qi Hai Rui's death and breaks ties with Yu Xiu Ming. Determined to save Qi Hai Rui, Ye Ling Shuang reverses time and returns to the Ye Bei of the past. Can she change what has already happened? And what will become of her relationship with Yu Xiu Ming?

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: The Taste Of Us
programme.desc: Delicious food, bursting with color, aroma, and flavor, not only fills the stomach but also soothes the soul! Liangliang (Mason Fung), a freelancer who loves singing and food, is feeling lost after breaking up with his girlfriend Jessica (Carmen Ngai). To prove his financial independence, he rents out his vacant room. His tenant, Azhi (Zeno Koo ), is a cooking enthusiast who frequently unleashes his culinary skills, creating a variety of heartwarming dishes such as "Miso Clam Soup" and "Chicken and Avocado Mexican Rolls"... The two young men hit it off immediately, satisfying each other's hunger and filling each other's voids! What kind of interesting relationship will these two very different personalities build?

programme.title: Kwoks And What, The
programme.desc: Seasoned Chinese frog closure instructor Kwok-Law Mei-lan (Paw Hee Ching) has raised her children and grandchildren by herself. She discovers everybody's issues before her 70th birthday. Her eldest son Kwok Tak-kan's (Joe Ma) business has failed, and he is also divorcing his wife Tian Yu-fei (Natalie Tong). Her second daughter Kwok Tak-bo (Che Yuen Yuen) and her son Kwok King-hin (Fei Wu) are drifting apart, and her relationship with her boyfriend has also ended. Her youngest son Kwok Tak-ming (Mat Yeung) loses his job as Tak-kan has got him into trouble. While Mei-lan wants to help her children solve their problems, she also plans to team up with her favorite disciple Chong Zi-chang (Grace Wong) to pass down the craft. Meanwhile, Tak-kan and his siblings keep contradicting each other. And gangster Kwok Chung-shek (Eddie Kwan) abruptly shows up and claims he has 50% ownership of the Kwoks' property. Can Mei-lan's strict adherence to the Kwoks motto “Keep walking and there's a way out” unite family members in the confrontation against the enemy?

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2021
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. programme.title: Hands Up 2026

The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Legal Mavericks 2020
programme.desc: Blind barrister Man Sun-hop (Vincent Wong), aka Perception Man, has a superlative fourth sense. He teams up with female legal executive Chiu Ching-mui (Sisley Choi) and private investigator Kut Yat-ha (Owen Cheung) to seek justice for the underprivileged. They never hesitate to use tactics that involve “pushing the boundaries”. Barrister Shaw Mei-la (Kelly Cheung) earnestly approaches Sun-hop. They are then to fight it out in court. Also, Mei-la's pupil master Kan Siu-wang (Paul Chun) constantly back Mei-la up. While Sun-hop was serving his pupillage with his pupil master Siu-wang, a homicide case involving some missing corpse had caused Shifu and his disciple to become foes. Sun-hop presents new evidence and lodges an appeal for the defendant. He and Siu-wang again confront each other, causing successive rounds of conflict. Meanwhile, the emergence of Mei-la brings about subtle changes in the formidable Sun-hop, Ching-mui and Yat-ha's triangular relationship.

Director Lai Fengqi, Taiwanese-American singer Rong Zhonghao, artist Yang Zili, music producer Chen Hongjia, and Liu Lixue, the "father of Chinese computers" from Canada, will also reveal their comfortable homes on the show.

The final five faced a final test, creating two outfits each based on a unisex and evening gown theme, which they then paired with their artists to showcase their style on the Catwalk stage, where the champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up were determined! Hosts Nancy Wu and Benjamin Yuen, along with "star" judges Walter Ma, William So, Gigi Leung, Kathy Chow, Amanda S., and others, witnessed the journey of "The Tailoring Magician".

Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Hong Kong: Never Too Small
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Music Money Monster
programme.desc: Pushing the limits of vocal range and precise timing, the brand-new interactive music game show Music Money Monster" is hosted by Sammy, Eric Kwok, and Lee Yin-tung. A professional pitch analysis system tests the contestants. A nine-square grid represents nine difficulty levels. Contestants who connect three lines to "pass the level" can choose to withdraw their winnings, continue the challenge, or even attempt the most difficult Monster level. Failure results in zero prize money! The amateur version allows solo participants to compete for a top prize of NT$100,000. The celebrity version offers viewers a chance to win prizes and gifts by interacting with the contestants in the live stream and sending emojis to cheer them on.

programme.title: J Music 2026
programme.desc: J Music is dedicated to creating a high-quality music platform, providing singers with opportunities to showcase their musical talents while allowing music fans to gain a deeper understanding of their musical stories. New faces in the music scene will also appear, showcasing their musical potential through interactive exchanges. Furthermore, each episode closely follows the latest developments on the Jade Solid Gold Chart, featuring music videos and interviews with various singers, songwriters, and producers, who discuss their work and the people and events within the music industry.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: King Of Snooker, The
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant. His purpose cannot be more obvious: he is waiting for someone to solve the game. KIU comes to know KAN TSZ HIM (Patrick Tang) by chance. Noticing his flair for the snooker, KIU decides to make an exception for HIM and teaches him all he knows about the game. Later, KAN manages to persuade her father into taking her in as well.

programme.title: Brick Slaves
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work. In order to continue to pay the mortgage, YIU-MING has no other choice but to accept the unreasonable condition imposed by KIN-CHING, however the two often have arguments due to their differences in lifestyles. Later on, YIU-MING unveils that there is quite a story behind KIN-CHING's personality that makes everyone keep a distance from her. Eventually, YIU-MING finds a new job with a property management company. Unknown to him, his arrival ruins LO PIT-TAT's (Mak Cheung Ching) hope of getting promoted, so PIT-TAT, a third-generation brick slave, for the sake of keeping his own job becomes completely incompatible with YIU-MING at work. Nevertheless, YIU-MING gains recognition from his boss, LI OI-WAH (Sheung Tin Ngor), who even urges him to specifically look after a trainee called CHUK PIK-KEI (Eliza Sam). Due to their work, YIU-MING and PIK-KEI get to observe the world around the brick slaves. PIK-KEI gradually falls in love with YIU-MING, yet YIU-MING knows very well whom he really loves. All of a sudden, KIN-CHING requests to end the tenancy......

programme.title: The Runner
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive. However, Wong-po and Yuen Nik keep agitating each other as Wong-po becomes Windchasers' sponsor. Yuen Nik's buddy Lai Shun-fan (Max Cheung) asks Yuen Nik to look after his young son Mak Yu-sun. The duo gradually develop an amicable mentor-disciple relationship. And Shun-fan and Ka-yan actually had some emotional issues. Shun-fan then becomes self-destructive due to some serious illness. Yuen Nik is determined to make him pick himself up. Meanwhile, Yuen Nik takes a good look at himself as he wants to again set foot on the runway.

programme.title: Rosy Business
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI's (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife. KIU's first and second wives, YAN FUNG YEE (Tse Suet Sum) and PANG KIU (Sheung Tin Ngor, Kiki), always make things difficult for KEI. KEI, who is an extremely clever person who never wastes time on trivial things, turns every threat into an opportunity. This makes KIU appreciate her wisdom and persistence. He entrusts his business to her and tells her to find a suitable successor for him before he dies. Despite all the attacks in the family, KEI manages to keep the business in good shape. She has never forgotten KIU's last wish, too. By chance, she discovers that TSEUNG PIT CHING (Ng Cheuk Hai, Ron), KIU's second son, is not really a playboy but an upright person loved by everyone in the shop. She therefore guides and helps him in every possible way, but her efforts are met with CHAI KAU's (Lai Yiu Cheung) challenges. KAU seeks vengeance for being mistreated and wants a pay back from TSEUNG family. After rounds after rounds of battle wits and actual fights, KEI and KAU begin to appreciate each other. KAU even falls for KEI as time goes by…

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins. Apart from his discovery of HAU-YEE's dubious death, the best friend of the late HAU-YEE, TONG BING-BING (Tavia Yeung) also has a feeling of suspicion, so the two decide to launch an investigation.

programme.title: King Of Snooker, The
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant. His purpose cannot be more obvious: he is waiting for someone to solve the game. KIU comes to know KAN TSZ HIM (Patrick Tang) by chance. Noticing his flair for the snooker, KIU decides to make an exception for HIM and teaches him all he knows about the game. Later, KAN manages to persuade her father into taking her in as well.

programme.title: Brick Slaves
programme.desc: LAU YIU-MING (Vincent Wong) exhausts the money that he and his girlfriend have saved for many years to buy a property and is about to get married. Out of the blue, his girlfriend not only wants to break up with him, but also secretly leases the premises out to a piano teacher, CHOI KIN-CHING (Selena Li). Unfortunately, YIU-MING's bad day gets even worse as he is soon laid off from work. In order to continue to pay the mortgage, YIU-MING has no other choice but to accept the unreasonable condition imposed by KIN-CHING, however the two often have arguments due to their differences in lifestyles. Later on, YIU-MING unveils that there is quite a story behind KIN-CHING's personality that makes everyone keep a distance from her. Eventually, YIU-MING finds a new job with a property management company. Unknown to him, his arrival ruins LO PIT-TAT's (Mak Cheung Ching) hope of getting promoted, so PIT-TAT, a third-generation brick slave, for the sake of keeping his own job becomes completely incompatible with YIU-MING at work. Nevertheless, YIU-MING gains recognition from his boss, LI OI-WAH (Sheung Tin Ngor), who even urges him to specifically look after a trainee called CHUK PIK-KEI (Eliza Sam). Due to their work, YIU-MING and PIK-KEI get to observe the world around the brick slaves. PIK-KEI gradually falls in love with YIU-MING, yet YIU-MING knows very well whom he really loves. All of a sudden, KIN-CHING requests to end the tenancy......

programme.title: The Runner
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive. However, Wong-po and Yuen Nik keep agitating each other as Wong-po becomes Windchasers' sponsor. Yuen Nik's buddy Lai Shun-fan (Max Cheung) asks Yuen Nik to look after his young son Mak Yu-sun. The duo gradually develop an amicable mentor-disciple relationship. And Shun-fan and Ka-yan actually had some emotional issues. Shun-fan then becomes self-destructive due to some serious illness. Yuen Nik is determined to make him pick himself up. Meanwhile, Yuen Nik takes a good look at himself as he wants to again set foot on the runway.

programme.title: Rosy Business
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI's (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife. KIU's first and second wives, YAN FUNG YEE (Tse Suet Sum) and PANG KIU (Sheung Tin Ngor, Kiki), always make things difficult for KEI. KEI, who is an extremely clever person who never wastes time on trivial things, turns every threat into an opportunity. This makes KIU appreciate her wisdom and persistence. He entrusts his business to her and tells her to find a suitable successor for him before he dies. Despite all the attacks in the family, KEI manages to keep the business in good shape. She has never forgotten KIU's last wish, too. By chance, she discovers that TSEUNG PIT CHING (Ng Cheuk Hai, Ron), KIU's second son, is not really a playboy but an upright person loved by everyone in the shop. She therefore guides and helps him in every possible way, but her efforts are met with CHAI KAU's (Lai Yiu Cheung) challenges. KAU seeks vengeance for being mistreated and wants a pay back from TSEUNG family. After rounds after rounds of battle wits and actual fights, KEI and KAU begin to appreciate each other. KAU even falls for KEI as time goes by…

programme.title: Silver Chamber Of Sorrows, The
programme.desc: “Sheung's Silver Chamber”, the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM's family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG's younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM's family. Fueled by hatred, CHING SAU-HANG (Ng Wing Mei), WAN's lover, marries HANG and ironically becomes WAN's sister-in-law. WAN falls out with HANG, and opts to live abroad and disconnects from his family. After leaving home for years, WAN does not return home until the occasion to celebrate his father's birthday. Tension between the two brothers comes to a head when HANG is reluctant to pay ransom to save the youngest son of WAN. WAN is determined to disconnect completely from his family ever since. Since WAN's return, SAU-HANG suffers from her husband's neglect and gets framed for causing the fourth concubine FEI FEI's (Wu Ting Yan) miscarriage. Hatred leads her to commit act that revenge. She seeks to subvert SHEUNG's family by luring KWAN. Intentionally, she unveils TSAU KUK (Yeung Sze Ki), the maid in the family, is HANG's illegitimate daughter. The dark age of a once-prominent family begins…

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long's two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei's (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love. The two sisters have found the right guys. Tsz-long and Hoi-kei never miss any job opportunity as they want to have their own love nest. The couple move into a 100-square-foot plus subdivided unit after getting married. They not only have to deal with daily inconveniences due to insufficient space but also need to handle emotional issues of their aging parents on both sides.

programme.title: Ultimate Addiction, The
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases. His brother-in-law CHOW SUN-YUNG (Ben Wong), one of the CCB inspectors, is determined to put him in jail, collaborating with superior HO SHEUNG-YEE (Sharon Chan) and subordinate CHI NGA (Kate Tsui) to gather evidence. SUN-YUNG thinks highly of CHI NGA and even regards her as his last apprentice, to his surprise, CHI NGA suddenly resigns and starts working for CHEUK YUK.

programme.title: Legend Of Master Chai, The
programme.desc: In Heaven, Chai (Leung Wing Chun) killed Huen (Ho Po Sang) over a pot of sweet lotus seed soup. He was expelled to earth to suffer, while at the same time, he had to help Huen and Nui, who were also sent down to earth, to regain their powers. Chai was punished to become the stupid and shabby son, of an earthly man. Huen, on the other hand, was his handsome and clever brother, who was loved by all. One day, Chai regained his magic power and started to challenge Huen. Their relationship worsened as they both fell in love with Nui (Leung Siu Bing)…

programme.title: My Daughter Is A Zombie
programme.desc: Filem Ini Mengisahkan Tentang Seorang Lelaki Berusaha Melindungi Anak Perempuannya Yang Dijangkiti Virus Zombi, Sehingga Pihak Berkuasa Menemui Penawar Yang Memulihkan Anaknya. Lee Jung-hwan, Seorang Penjinak Haiwan Yang Hidup Bahagia Bersama Anak Perempuannya, Soo-ah. Namun Keadaan Berubah Apabila Virus Gar Mula Merebak Di Bandar Dan Sesiapa Yang Dijangkiti Akan Bertukar Menjadi Zombi. Dalam Usaha Mereka Melarikan Diri Ke Kampung Halaman, Soo-ah Turut Dijangkiti. Walau Bagaimanapun, Jung-hwan Tetap Membawa Soo-ah Pulang Ke Kampungnya, Eunbong-ri, Tempat Ibunya Kim Bam-soon Tinggal. Jung-hwan Berusaha Sedaya Upaya Menyembunyikan Keadaan Soo-ah Agar Dia Tidak Dibawa Pergi Atau Dibunuh Oleh Pihak Berkuasa. Jung-hwan Kemudian Melatih Soo-ah Untuk Mengawal Naluri Zombinya Dengan Harapan Dia Tidak Mencederakan Sesiapa. Walaupun Soo-ah Telah Bertukar Menjadi Zombi, Dia Masih Menunjukkan Sifat Kemanusiaan Yang Membuatkan Jung-hwan Dan Bam-soon Berharap Untuk Memulihkannya. Tidak Lama Kemudian, Shin Yeon-hwa, Rakan Lama Jung-hwan Telah Mengetahui Rahsia Tersebut Dan Pada Mulanya Berniat Membunuh Soo-ah. Namun Niatnya Berubah Apabila Dia Melihat Soo-ah Masih Memiliki Naluri Manusia. Yeon-hwa Kemudian Membantu Soo-ah Menyesuaikan Diri Dengan Masyarakat Serta Menjaga Rahsia Jangkitan Itu. Namun, Keadaan Menjadi Huru-hara Apabila Jung-hwan Membawa Soo-ah Ke Taman Hiburan Dan Tingkah Laku Aneh Soo-ah Menarik Perhatian Netizen. Pihak Berkuasa Mula Memburunya. Jung-hwan Berusaha Melindungi Dan Melarikan Anaknya, Tetapi Dia Ditembak Sebelum Sempat Melaksanakan Rancangannya. Tindak Balas Luar Biasa Soo-ah Selepas Itu Mengejutkan Anggota Tentera Yang Mengejarnya. Akhirnya Mereka Dibawa Kepada Para Saintis, Yang Mendapati Darah Jung-hwan Mengandungi Penawar Virus Tersebut. Mereka Menjalankan Kajian Dan Berjaya Menyembuhkan Jangkitan Dalam Tubuh Soo-ah. Soo-ah Akhirnya Pulih, Namun Jung-hwan Kekal Dalam Keadaan Koma.
